items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: And the band manager, he got mad about that, and he got me fired. But I'm kind of glad he got me fired. I'll get some of that off there. I'll call his name, you might know him. His name is Eric Begaard.

ctx.x: Well what I used to do every night, tell you the truth, that's how I lost the job too. I'd get down off the bandstand about twelve o'clock, I'd go to the man's restroom, wash my face up and sit around there and take a nap. And the band manager, he got mad about that, and he got me fired. But I'm kind of glad he got me fired. I'll get some of that off there. I'll call his name, you might know him. His name is Eric Begaard. Oh yeah.
